notes: Prioritize Poison Cleansing Totem for Mass Envenom recovery and reliable personal snare removal for Paralyzing Shots; interrupt Toxic Atrophy.
Poison removal covers Toxic Spew; movement removal is a comfort option for Spore Spines and Bloodthorn Roots.
Cleanse Insatiable Hunger and Toxic Spores; interrupt Healing Breeze first and Purge only as recovery if its Magic effect completes.
Cleanse landed Hex and Poison effects, and Purge Bound by Shadow, Unholy Mending, or Captain's Bulwark when needed.
Bring Poison Cleansing Totem for Heartstop Poison, Cleanse Spirit for Curse of Doom, and Purge for Fel Crazed.
Purge Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier; snare removal is a comfort option.
Bring poison and curse removal for missed Poisoned Cheap Shot or Addle Mind casts and for Cytotoxin; the source matrix does not rate Purge as required for Enhancement.
Poison Cleansing Totem covers Poison Splash, Mind-Numbing Poison, and Corrosive Essence; keep Spirit Walk for personal root recovery.

recommendations: Capacitor Totem with Static Charge can stop groups of casts; Wind Shear or Purge can handle individual emergencies.
No dedicated utility swap is required; swap to and focus the emissary.
No dedicated utility swap is required; position early to intercept partner orbs.
Cleanse Spirit and Poison Cleansing Totem remove eligible shields.
Spirit Walk or Thunderous Paws can clear the personal slow, while Wind Rush Totem with Jet Stream can clear slows for the group.

provenance.description: Original structured transcription of the always, comfort, and unused utility ratings in wordup's Enhancement Shaman Mythic+ guide, updated for Patch 12.1.0. Talent build strings are intentionally excluded.
